raging-sea-power.name: Raging Sea Phantom Power
raging-sea-power.rulesText: Main: draw three cards, then discard two cards from your hand.

sea-city-noble.name: Noble of the Azure Sea City
sea-city-noble.rulesText: ① Tap: add one sea energy.

sea-depths.name: Seafloor Abyss
sea-depths.rulesText: Main: special deploy one Land from your graveyard.

sea-domain.name: Azure Sea Domain
sea-domain.rulesText: This card is exempt from the deck copy limit. ① Tap: add one sea energy.

sea-god-caller-haya.name: Haya, Caller of the Sea God
sea-god-caller-haya.rulesText: ① When summoned: you may reveal the top six cards of your deck, choose one Azure Giant Creature and one Relic from among them and add them to your hand, and discard the rest. ② When summoned and on attack: discard the top two cards of the opponent's deck.

sea-god-wrath-jormungandr.name: Jormungandr, Wrath of the Sea God
sea-god-wrath-jormungandr.rulesText: While there is a card with Loki in its name on your field, this card's cost is treated as 3 sea and 1 colorless. ① (effect once per turn) Speed; 1 sea: discard one card at random from the opponent's hand. ② On attack: mill 5 cards from the opponent's deck.

sea-patrol.name: Azure Sea Patrol
sea-patrol.rulesText: ① When summoned: discard the top 2 cards of the opponent's deck.

seaborn-illusionist.name: Illusionist Returned from the Sea
seaborn-illusionist.rulesText: ① When summoned: this turn, your Azure Giant Creatures mill 1 additional card. ② On attack: mill one card from the opponent's deck.

sealed-aurora-dragon-statue.name: Sealed Aurora Dragon Statue
sealed-aurora-dragon-statue.rulesText: ① While this Creature has fewer than three ice crystal counters, it cannot attack or block. ② Whenever you place an Aurora counter, place one ice crystal counter on this Creature.

shadowwood-sword.name: Shadowwood Sword
shadowwood-sword.rulesText: Equip condition: Phantom Puppet Creature. The equipped Creature gets +1 power. ① While equipped; on attack: one opponent Creature gets -1 maximum life permanently.

shifting-sea-lokinia.name: Lokinia, the Shifting Sea
shifting-sea-lokinia.rulesText: ① When summoned; Shifting Sea: you may reveal the top six cards of the opponent's deck, choose one Creature and add it to your hand, and discard the rest. ② On attack: for each Creature the opponent has, you may mill one card from the opponent's deck.

shifting-sea-temple.name: Shifting Temple
shifting-sea-temple.rulesText: ① Your Azure Giant Creatures mill 1 additional card. ② Tap: grant one of your Azure Giant Creatures "On attack, mill one card from the opponent's deck".

sunken-ship.name: Sunken Great Ship
sunken-ship.rulesText: When this card is discarded: add one sea energy. When deployed: discard the top three cards of the opponent's deck.

swift-spirit-envoy.name: Swift Spirit Envoy
swift-spirit-envoy.rulesText: Speed: you may summon this card from your hand. ① When summoned: if there is another Swift Spirit Creature on your field, draw a card.
